text:
Jules P: Quick post-chaos note: EU tenant briefly accepted writes in us-east after heartbeat gap. Control plane still showed eu owner.
Mei L: Oof. So sidecar did local takeover without any cross-region consent.
Carlos G: We should standardize a tokenized handoff. Signed by origin region KMS, short TTL, monotonic seq. Dataplane verifies signature + seq > persisted-watermark.
Jules P: Example header:
```
X-Handoff: eyJraWQiOiJldS0xIiwi...
X-Issuer: eu-1
X-Expiry: 3555554340
X-Seq: 42
```
Mei L: Persisted watermark avoids unbounded nonce caches. On restart read watermark from local store. For cross-region require witness endpoint or explicit tenant consent flag.
Carlos G: Two modes: local-fast (same-region only) vs witness-guarded (cross-region). Shadow-commit is an option but hurts read-after-write.
security-bot: created ticket H-901: "handoff-token-prototype"; attached traces.
Jules P: Next: RFC for token claims + revoke/rotation semantics, PoC for sidecar verify + witness stub, sim matrix covering replay, watermark wipe, KMS rotate. Mei will draft RFC, Carlos will PoC.
Mei L: Loop legal for token claims proving residency provenance.
Jules P: Gate cross-region auto-handoff behind tenant consent initially. :white_check_mark:
